display.purpose: The name, and nothing else. The only Petrona on the page. Carries a ~4% size premium over the rest of the scale because Petrona's x-height runs smaller than the body face.

title.purpose: The role line: uppercase, tracked 0.14em, centered between two short green rules.

body.purpose: Description copy (capped at 30rem) and every link label.

label.purpose: Section headings and the expander summary. Uppercase, tracked 0.14em, muted ink.

meta.purpose: Dates and the footer stamp. Tabular numerals so stacked dates align down the column.

note.purpose: Short disambiguating notes beside a link label. Same size as Meta, but no tracking and no tabular figures — it is prose, not a measurement.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing curve in the system. Fast out, settled landing.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: The only duration. Zeroed to 0ms at the token level under prefers-reduced-motion, so no component needs its own media query.

motion.name: dur-grow
motion.purpose: Ambient motion only: the margin specimens growing in on load. Far longer than an interaction duration because nothing waits on it. Zeroed under prefers-reduced-motion, landing on the resting state.

motion.name: ease-grow
motion.purpose: Starts slow and settles long, the way a thing grows. A standard UI ease-out finished in the first third and then crawled.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Max-width query: the QR mat narrows from 512px to 320px.

breakpoints.name: pointer-fine
breakpoints.purpose: Capability query, not a size query. Pointer devices get the circular portrait; anything touch-capable keeps the scannable QR.

breakpoints.name: note-wrap
breakpoints.purpose: Max-width query: a link row wraps and its note drops under the label instead of riding beside it.

breakpoints.name: gutter
breakpoints.purpose: The margin specimens switch treatment. Above it a gutter exists and two live in it; below it one fringes the right edge instead.

components.name: Link Row
components.description: The workhorse: a hairline-bordered specimen label holding an inlined Font Awesome SVG and a text label. The icon is the only thing that greens on hover.
components.css: .ds-link-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #d8d2c4; border-radius: 2px; text-decoration: none; color: #1c1a17; background: transparent; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-link-row svg { width: 1.4em; height: 1.4em; flex-shrink: 0; color: #5a554d; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-link-row:hover, .ds-link-row:focus-visible { background: #ebe4d4; border-color: #5a554d; } .ds-link-row:hover svg, .ds-link-row:focus-visible svg { color: #3f5a3a; } .ds-link-row:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-link-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f5a3a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Extras Row
components.description: The Link Row's dated variant, used for talks, decks, and companion artifacts. Label and tabular-numeral date stack in a 0.25rem column beside the icon, and the icon pins to the first line of the label rather than centering against the whole block.
components.css: .ds-extra-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #d8d2c4; border-radius: 2px; text-decoration: none; color: #1c1a17; background: transparent; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-extra-row svg { width: 1.4em; height: 1.4em; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: calc((1em * 1.55 - 1.4em) / 2); color: #5a554d; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-extra-content { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-extra-content .ds-date-stamp { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #6b6559; } .ds-extra-row:hover, .ds-extra-row:focus-visible { background: #ebe4d4; border-color: #5a554d; } .ds-extra-row:hover svg, .ds-extra-row:focus-visible svg { color: #3f5a3a; } .ds-extra-row:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-extra-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f5a3a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Expander Summary
components.description: A native <details>/<summary> with its marker removed. Borrows the row's border and hover wash but takes the tracked-caps Label voice, so it reads as an instruction to the sheet rather than an entry on it. The label swaps to "Show less" when open, in CSS off the [open] attribute.
components.html:
Show more (3)Show less
Additional specimens mount here.
components.css: .ds-expander { width: 100%; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-expander-summary { list-style: none; min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #d8d2c4; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; text-align: center; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5a554d; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-expander-summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-expander-less, .ds-expander[open] .ds-expander-more { display: none; } .ds-expander[open] .ds-expander-less { display: inline; } .ds-expander-summary:hover, .ds-expander-summary:focus-visible { background: #ebe4d4; border-color: #5a554d; } .ds-expander-summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f5a3a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-expander-body { margin-top: 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: #5a554d; }

components.name: Avatar Mat
components.description: Signature. The QR code mounted on a pure-white ground with a double frame: outer 1px border plus a second hairline inset 0.5rem via ::before. Pinned light in both themes for scan reliability. The checkered field here stands in for the generated QR image.
components.css: .ds-avatar-mat { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 320px; background: #ffffff; padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #d8d2c4; } .ds-avatar-mat::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #d8d2c4; pointer-events: none; } .ds-avatar-code { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; background-color: #ffffff; background-image: repeating-conic-gradient(#000 0% 25%, #ffffff 0% 50%); background-size: 16px 16px; }

components.name: Portrait Avatar
components.description: The same element on pointer-fine devices: the mat dissolves (transparent, zero padding) and the border becomes a ring hugging a circular portrait.
components.css: .ds-avatar-portrait { width: 100%; max-width: 240px; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #d8d2c4; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%, #ebe4d4 0 28%, #d8d2c4 28% 100%); }

components.name: Role Line
components.description: Signature. Tracked-caps role held between two 1.5rem accent rules drawn with ::before and ::after — the only place a rule and the accent color meet.
components.css: .ds-role-line { margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.75rem; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5a554d; } .ds-role-line::before, .ds-role-line::after { content: ""; flex-shrink: 0; width: 1.5rem; height: 1px; background: #3f5a3a; }

components.name: Botanical Ornament
components.description: Signature. A hand-plotted leaf between two rules, replacing the divider above a section. The system's single decorative flourish, and load-bearing — it is what makes the page feel drawn.
components.html: Extras
components.css: .ds-ornament { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; color: #3f5a3a; } .ds-ornament svg { display: block; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; } .ds-ornament-heading { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5a554d; }

components.name: Date Stamp
components.description: The quietest tier: tabular numerals at 0.06em tracking, used for extra dates and the footer's Updated stamp so stacked dates align down the column.
components.css: .ds-footer-stamp { text-align: center; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #6b6559; }

components.name: Margin Specimen
components.description: Signature. One of eight hand-plotted herbs mounted in the page margin, drawn in thinned ink at the page's own hairline weight. Two flank the column above 56rem; one fringes the right edge below it. Never crosses a reading edge or the QR mat.
components.css: .ds-specimen { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem 0; color: color-mix(in oklab, #5a554d 62%, transparent); } .ds-specimen-svg { height: 320px; width: auto; display: block; animation: ds-grow 2600ms cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.25, 1) backwards; mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, #000 0 var(--ds-grow, 100%), transparent calc(var(--ds-grow, 100%) + 14%)); } @property --ds-grow { syntax: '<percentage>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 100%; } @keyframes ds-grow { from { --ds-grow: -15%; } }

components.description: The provenance line and date stamp at the foot of the sheet, read as one annotation block rather than two stray lines. The page's quietest tier.

narrative.overview:
The page is a specimen mounted on warm paper. The QR avatar sits inside a double-ruled mat — an outer border and an inner hairline inset 8px from it — the way a pressed leaf is framed and labeled on an archival sheet. Below it the name is set once in a warm humanist serif, the role is a tracked-out caps line held between two short green rules, and every link is a hairline-bordered entry mounted in the same column. Where a lesser page would put a `<hr>`, this one draws a leaf.

The register is handmade and tactile, with a little wryness. The hand is visible on purpose: the ornament is a four-command SVG path someone plotted by hand, not a glyph from an icon set; the display face is a warm humanist serif whose letterforms keep a drawn, faintly calligraphic hand rather than a drafted one; the accent green is the color of a dried specimen rather than a brand. Nothing here is generated-looking, and nothing here shouts. There is exactly one chromatic voice on the entire page, and it is used about six times.

That same hand extends past the column. Hairline herbs are mounted in the margins and grow up from the bottom edge on load, dealt fresh from a set of eight on every visit — the only thing on the page that is not identical between two readers. They are drawn, not decorated: thinned ink at the page's own line weight, in the margin and nowhere else, and they never cross a reading edge or the QR code.

Density is generous and vertical. One column, 36rem wide, centered in the viewport, stacked at a 1.5rem rhythm — the page is meant to be read in a hallway on a phone, seconds after someone scanned the code that is now looking back at them from the screen. It explicitly rejects the bio-link SaaS look (pill buttons, gradient hero, candy cards), the dev-portfolio dark-neon look (terminal green on black, mono everything, glow), and the generic SaaS landing look (rounded-xl cards, blue-500, soft drop shadows, Inter).
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and ink, never white-and-gray
One green, used sparingly, as the only chroma
Hairline rules do all structural work; zero shadows
Near-square 2px corners — the desktop portrait is the only circle
Serif display voice used exactly once; everything else humanist grotesque
Uppercase, widely tracked labels for anything secondary
A drawn botanical ornament in place of a divider
Hand-plotted herbs in the margins, varying per visit, never over content

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Pressed Fern gets four jobs: the rules flanking the role, the ornament, icons on hover/focus, and the focus ring. It is never a fill, never a border color, never body text, never a link color at rest. Its rarity is what makes the page feel tended rather than branded.

rules.name: The Un-themed QR Rule
rules.body: The QR mat and code stay pure black on pure white in every theme. A phone camera in bad venue lighting outranks palette coherence. Do not add `prefers-color-scheme` overrides for `{colors.qr-white}`.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: No neutral on this page is achromatic. Every gray carries the paper's yellow-warm cast. Dropping a `#888` or a `#f5f5f5` into this system reads instantly as foreign.

rules.name: The Single Serif Rule
rules.body: Petrona appears exactly once per page, on the name. The moment a second element takes the serif, the name stops being the anchor. (The OG card is the one sanctioned exception: it sets both the name and the role line in Petrona, because a 1200×630 card has no hairline system to carry hierarchy.)

rules.name: The Tracked-Caps Rule
rules.body: Anything secondary — role, section heading, expander — is uppercase at `0.14em`. Never letterspace lowercase text, and never set body copy in caps.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: 400 and 500 are the entire weight vocabulary. Emphasis comes from size, case, tracking, and color tier — never from a heavier cut.

rules.name: The Tabular Date Rule
rules.body: Every date on the page is `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` at `0.06em`, so a stacked list of dates aligns down the column.

rules.name: The Capability-Not-Width Rule
rules.body: The avatar switch is decided by `hover` and `pointer`, not by viewport alone. A phone held in landscape at 800px is still a phone, and it still gets the QR.

rules.name: The Gutter-Is-Earned Rule
rules.body: Anything living outside the column sizes itself from the space that actually exists — `(50vw - half the column - air)` — rather than from a viewport width guess. It then shrinks to nothing on its own as the margin closes, with no breakpoint needed to hide it.

rules.name: The Drawn-Not-Lit Rule
rules.body: Flat is the default and shadows are a smell. If a future element genuinely needs to float above the sheet — a dialog, a lifted card — it may earn one, but it must be argued for, not reached for. Ambient shadows on resting surfaces are always wrong here.

rules.name: The 2px Rule
rules.body: `2px` or `50%`. Nothing in between — no `4px`, no `8px`, no `rounded-xl`.

rules.name: The Greening Icon Rule
rules.body: The icon is the only thing that changes color on hover. It is the system's smallest, most-repeated moment of life; do not add a color change to the label too.

rules.name: The Answering Label Rule
rules.body: A control's label states what the control will do next, never what it did. A toggle still reading "Show more" while its rows are open is a broken control, not a styling detail.

rules.name: The Right-Edge Rule
rules.body: On a phone the specimen goes on the right. Every link row is left-aligned — icon, then label — so the left edge is where the eye lands on every line. Measured on the real page, the same plant on the left touches seven text elements including all six link labels; on the right it touches three, and none of them is a label.

rules.name: The Watermark-Not-Wallpaper Rule
rules.body: Background botanicals are drawn in thinned ink at hairline weight, and they never sit behind a QR code, a control, or the start of a line. If a specimen would cross a reading edge, move it or mask it — do not merely fade it, because the opacity that stops it being a distraction also stops it being visible.

dos: **Do** keep Pressed Fern to its four jobs — flanking rules, ornament, icon hover, focus ring. New accents belong nowhere.
**Do** build depth with 1px rules in the `rule` color, and let `:active` `translateY(1px)` carry the tactility.
**Do** compose any new section the same way the Extras section is composed: ornament, tracked-caps heading, then specimen rows.
**Do** set every date with `tabular-nums` and `0.06em` tracking so columns of dates align.
**Do** honor the `44px` minimum hit height on anything interactive — this page is used on phones, one-handed, standing up.

**Do** route interaction motion through `--dur` / `--ease` (180ms), and ambient motion through `--dur-grow` / `--ease-grow` (2600ms). Both are zeroed by `prefers-reduced-motion` at the token level, and every animation's resting state is its end state, so zeroing a duration lands on the finished result rather than hiding it.
**Do** self-host any new font or icon and inline it at build time; nothing on this page fetches from a third party at load.
**Do** keep the QR mat pure black-on-white in every theme.
donts: **Don't** add a `box-shadow` to a resting surface. Flat is the default; a floating element must justify itself.
**Don't** introduce a radius other than `2px` or `50%`.
**Don't** set a second element on the page in Petrona, or add a weight beyond 400 and 500.
**Don't** use an achromatic gray — every neutral here is warm.
**Don't** letterspace lowercase text, or set body copy in uppercase.

**Don't** drift toward the three rejected worlds: bio-link SaaS (pill buttons, gradients, candy cards), dev-portfolio dark neon (mono everything, glow, terminal green), or generic SaaS landing (rounded-xl, blue-500, Inter, drop shadows).
**Don't** widen the column past `36rem` or run description copy past `30rem`.
**Don't** swap the QR avatar out of the anchor position — it is the page's identity device and it circulates offline.
**Don't** let a background element cross a reading edge, a control, or the QR mat. The margin is the only place it may live.
**Don't** give the margin specimens the accent green. They are structure in thinned ink; the green stays on its four jobs.
